pages: Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, stands at the frame and picks type with one steel composing stick held in her left hand. Middle: the fount case, its boxes in racks. Background: the shop window over the saddler's. Light: low afternoon sun through the glass.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, holds one lead sort face up towards her and reads it upside down by its shape. Middle: the steel composing stick on the stone, a paper slip. Background: the fount case, the frame. Light: low gas and window light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, carries one galley of set type to the imposing stone with both hands. Middle: the chase and quoins, a coil of string. Background: the shop floor, the press in the next room. Light: bright morning through the window.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, pushes one extra lead space into the line with the knee of the composing stick. Middle: the fount case, the copy clipped to the frame. Background: the shop, wet grey light. Light: low afternoon, six o'clock.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, stands alone at the frame with one galley of type squared on the stone. Middle: the imposing stone, a low gas jet. Background: the case in shadow, the shut window. Light: one low gas flame.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, takes one paper packet of eleven point spaces out of the upper case into her hand. Middle: the drawer of ten point spaces, the stick. Background: the fount case, the frame. Light: low grey window light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, tips one small box of sorts out onto the stone ledge and looks through them. Middle: the composing stick, the fount case. Background: the shop, the door shut. Light: low afternoon sun, one lamp.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, holds one proof sheet up to the window light and lays her thumb on a white band. Middle: the locked forme, a pencil. Background: the proof press, the reading desk. Light: noon light through dusty glass.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, lays one hand flat on the dented lump of type in the column above hers. Middle: the locked chase, the quoins. Background: the shop, the press room door. Light: cool clear morning light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, sets one paper packet tied with string down on the reader's desk. Middle: the foundry slip, the o box on its lid. Background: the shop, the reading room beyond. Light: low morning light through glass.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, stands at the shut shop with one sheet of copy flat under her hand. Middle: the fount case, the bare stone frame. Background: dark windows, the stone floor. Light: one low gas jet, late at night.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, counts the second box along with one fingertip, head down over the case. Middle: the shop's book open on the ledge, the copy. Background: the shut shop, the long room. Light: dim gas light, late at night.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, turns one bright o over with her thumb and holds it to the light. Middle: the o box, the worn sorts beside it. Background: the fount case, the frame. Light: one low gas flame.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, holds one bright o against the notch of the steel body gauge and pushes. Middle: the gauge bar on the shelf, the o box. Background: the fount case, the shop wall. Light: low gas light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, smooths one proof slip flat on the reader's desk beside the tied packet. Middle: the steel body gauge, a pencil. Background: the reading desk, the shop beyond. Light: clear Friday morning light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, stands at the reading desk with one printed proof folded in her hand. Middle: the tied paper packet, a wooden chair. Background: the shop, the drying frame beyond the door. Light: low afternoon light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, fills one measure of loose type from the italic case at the end of the room. Middle: the italic fount on its frame, the shop's book. Background: the long room, the drying frame. Light: dim late light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, hangs one printed sheet on the drying frame among the others. Middle: the wooden delivery board, a bundle tied with string. Background: the press, the folding table. Light: bright afternoon light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, copies the errata note into the day book with one pen. Middle: the printed slip, the ink bottle. Background: the desk, the case in shadow. Light: low lamp light, evening.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, rules one line under the count in the day book and stops her pen on it. Middle: the ink bottle, the folded slip. Background: the desk, the shuttered window. Light: one low lamp.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, closes the second box along with one flat palm and writes in the shop's book. Middle: the tin on the shelf, the copy. Background: the fount case, the shut shop. Light: low Friday afternoon light.

Anne, a girl of seventeen, dark hair pinned up, a blue-and-white checked blouse with the sleeves turned back, a brown apron, sets one tin of sixty-one sorts down on the shelf beside the fount case. Middle: the day book, the reading desk. Background: the shop, the window dark. Light: one low lamp.
